overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly targeted academic and research-focused social media presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content resonates strongly with computational social science communities, showing robust engagement particularly around software releases, research publications, and career opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, software releases (CooRnet v2.0), and methodologies for detecting coordinated networks.
Recruitment drives for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Announcements of new research funding, paper publications, and upcoming academic presentations.

recommendations: Capitalize on Bluesky's high organic engagement rate by increasing post frequency and utilizing thread formats for paper summaries.
Utilize LinkedIn's professional reach for recruitment by adding external job application links and rich media to hiring posts.
Boost Mastodon engagement by centering content on open-source research tooling and developer-centric discussions.

platformInsights.bluesky: The highest-performing platform relative to follower size, commanding an average engagement rate of 6.14%. Users show extreme interest in publication launches and research opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a dedicated, highly technical audience. While absolute reach is lower, software updates like CooRnet yield a strong 5.64% engagement rate.
platformInsights.linkedin: The primary channel for driving absolute volume, with institutional announcements like research grants generating the highest overall likes (95) and comments (12).

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
